question: Do the assistant-provenance records in the incident prompt cause the generation failure?

method.edit: Replace the id span of each selected prompt line with the same number of a neutral filler id, so the prompt keeps its exact token count and every id outside the spans is byte-identical.
method.request: the incident's own prompt IDs at temperature 1, seed 7, top_p 1, top_k -1, max_output 1024, retain=false, fresh cache salt

arms.records: the four lines carrying a `[ctx] [assistant]` / `[assistant] The user asks` reasoning record
arms.broad: every line carrying assistant provenance: `[ctx] [assistant]`, `[assistant]`, `**[assistant]**`, source=session ref=.../assistant, cl:.../assistant, `[도구`

runtime.isolation: idle at admission (running empty, nothing waiting or queued), but production traffic, not an exclusive hold: served advanced by two in every arm
runtime.scope: quality observation on a production boot, not an isolated timing measurement

structure_finding.assistant_reasoning_in_prompt: the prompt carries the assistant's own reasoning as tool/memory records: `[ctx] [assistant] The user asks ...` (x4), `[assistant] The user asks ...` (x3), `**[assistant]** ...` (x2), `[도구 sessions] {"action":"search",...}`
structure_finding.recency: one such record carries 2026-09-17T20:46:56+09:00, two minutes before the incident request
structure_finding.older_records: the memory records that are 95-100 days old quote ordinary, coherent assistant prose, so the self-referential material is recent
structure_finding.not_a_cause: neutralizing it does not recover quality (see cases)

ruled_out.root_cause: assistant-provenance memory records are not the differentiator; both neutralized arms stay derailed
ruled_out.external_fix: stripping the records is hygiene, not the incident repair

gate_gap.observation: the canonical Korean glyph counters score all three outputs clean (0 replacement characters, 0 welded jamo, no Cyrillic or Thai) while the text is semantically broken
gate_gap.consequence: the incident needs a graded semantic case for a long agentic context; the glyph scan cannot see this failure
gate_gap.tool: bench/agentic-recall.py: one exact fact buried in a long agentic context, three decoys after it, graded without a judge

next_causal_gate.measurement: real-data selection: capture the sparse indexer's selected pool ids for the incident prefix and compare them with an fp32 reference selection recomputed from the same captured operands (q8, w_eff, keys, scales)
next_causal_gate.why: the selector kernels are verified on synthetic logits and the KDA operands were audited on real ones, but the selection itself has never been compared on real data; it is the only path here that engages for long contexts and content-dependently (short contexts take the covered path and never select)
